```python
    "employ": ["use", "utilize", "apply", "deploy", "hire"],
    "correspond": ["communicate", "write", "exchange messages", "liaise"],
    "dislike": ["despise", "hate", "loathe", "have an aversion to"],
    "help": ["assist", "aid", "support", "lend a hand"],
    "impossible": ["unattainable", "infeasible", "impractical", "out of reach"]
}

def replace_with_synonym(sentence, target_word, chosen_synonym):
    """Replaces a target word in a sentence with a chosen synonym."""
    if chosen_synonym in thesaurus.get(target_word, []):
        return sentence.replace(f" {target_word} ", f" {chosen_synonym} ")

        return sentence  # No change if synonym not in list

```
